reporting_taxonomy.not_executable: Not executable from frozen final dataset

methodological_boundaries.frozen_analysis_dataset: The professor-provided final CSVs are the provenance root because raw-to-final generation scripts were unavailable.
methodological_boundaries.external_selection_history: FS_NOAPS had prior professor-level external evidence; do not describe all external cohorts as pristine untouched model-selection holdouts.
methodological_boundaries.raw_external_priority: Alpha 3 raw external results remain the primary external validation and must never be replaced by recalibrated or sensitivity results.
methodological_boundaries.recalibration: Local recalibration is an adaptation sensitivity analysis and is reported separately from raw external validation.
methodological_boundaries.home_discharge: Home-discharge sensitivity is not reconstructed when discharge_location is absent.
